translations.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
translations.bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
translations.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
